data.action: 撑诊疗桌塌腰翘臀更衣整理受力，队服微敞羽织滑落，咬唇回眸微嗔喘息
data.camera: horizontal POV, leaning over treatment desk, arched spine, haori slipping, looking back
data.description: 【蝶屋敷诊疗间·熄灯后】「今晚的药，要用特别的方式服用。」忍双手撑在诊疗桌上，队服的下摆被推到腰际，白 belt 松开垂落。指尖抠紧了桌面，毒舌却还在逞强——「呼啊……这、这一剂有点烈哦……嘶哈、明明是医师……却被弄得……最没有形象……」
data.promptProse: Caught in a private examination after hours in the Butterfly Mansion's dispensary, Kochou Shinobu leans forward against the polished wooden treatment table, her butterfly haori slipping from petite pale shoulders. She glances back over her shoulder with an exquisite, biting pout and trembling purple eyes, fingers digging into the edge as her uniform belt hangs loose. Soft candlelight from the medicine cabinets illuminates the graceful arch of her spine and flushed thighs in a breathtaking horizontal composition, detailed background.
data.title: 蝴蝶忍 · 诊疗桌上的药方·「这一剂……有点烈哦」
